results.reason: Article 9(1) establishes the coordination council under the Minister of Education and covers all four deliberation/coordination purposes. Article 9(2) has at most 15 members, Education Minister as chair, Gender Equality and Family Minister as vice-chair, and all nine enumerated members. The three-year tenure/one reappointment rule, secretary designation and Presidential Decree delegation in paragraphs 3–5 correspond to the Korean original. Corrected candidate restores the policy-development and advisory function, committee terminology and paragraph numbering. No material altered citation or obligation detected.

Article 11(1) requires the State and local governments to provide victim-identification education to eight groups and submit results to the Minister of Gender Equality and Family. Corrected translation preserves references to Articles 21(2), 29 and 33; Immigration Control Act Articles 25-2 and 46-2; Labor Standards Act Article 101(1); Seafarers Act Article 125(1); and investigation/trial workers of national agencies. Article 11(2) delegates education contents, methods and target scope to Presidential Decree. No subject reversal, missing statutory item or changed legal duty detected.
